Since 1969, the company has been located in Siegsdorf as Brückner Maschinenbau and can now look back on an impressive company history: Brückner Maschinenbau is the world's leading supplier of machines and lines for the production of oriented plastic films. The company's huge, more than 150m long lines guarantee international film manufacturers a highly efficient and reliable production of a wide range of film types, which are used as high-quality packaging material and in technical applications. Brückner Maschinenbau's range of services includes the planning, construction and commissioning of film production lines, the realisation of complex industrial projects as well as all process and mechanical engineering developments for film production. For this reason, Brückner works on research and development projects in its Technology Centre in Siegsdorf, which was inaugurated in 1998, together with raw material manufacturers, film producers and processors on the basic development of film technologies.

title: Brückner Group SE - Extrusion-World
content: # Brückner Group SE. The Brückner Group has been family-owned since it was founded in 1960. This has characterised the Group to this day and is reflected in particular in its long-term strategic orientation - a key success factor for our customers and ourselves. Brückner Maschinenbau is the world's leading supplier of production systems for the manufacture of high-quality monoaxially and biaxially stretched films. It was founded in 1960. The systems guarantee customers efficient, profitable and reliable production of a wide variety of flexible films, which are used as high-quality packaging material or for special technical applications, such as capacitors, battery separators or screens and displays. Brückner Maschinenbau's range of services includes the planning, construction and commissioning of complete production plants and turnkey factories as well as all process and machine engineering developments for film production. The globally unique technology centre in Siegsdorf is increasingly working on important future topics such as e-mobility, intelligent packaging and sustainability in film production.

title: Brückner Maschinenbau
content: The Brückner Group is a family-owned consortium specializing in machine manufacturing and customized engineering solutions and services for the plastics and packaging industry. # For Your Plastic Film of Tomorrow. We are the world’s leading supplier of production lines for the manufacture of stretched films – used as finest packaging material or in high-tech applications. With cutting-edge solutions, a globally unique Technology Center, and deep insight into market needs, we help shaping production environments that are powerful, efficient, and built for lasting success across the entire value chain. ## Always in the Interests of our Customers. Market and feasibility studies, financing, film development, digital solutions or services - we help you in all project phases and - together with Brückner Servtec - throughout the entire life cycle. Thanks to our credo “Stretching the Limits”, as a film manufacturer you benefit from the combined know-how of our experts - whether in mechanical engineering, process engineering or software development.
